description.zh: 负载均衡器ID，用于唯一标识要查询的负载均衡器，负载均衡器创建时会直接返回，也可以通 [ListLoadBalancers](~~2868897~~) 接口获取站点下所有负载均衡器查询。
description.en: The ID of the load balancer, used to uniquely identify the load balancer to be queried. This ID is returned directly upon creation of the load balancer and can also be obtained through the [ListLoadBalancers](~~2868897~~) interface for querying all load balancers under a site.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the site, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) interface.

descriptions.zh: 通过负载均衡器ID，删除负载均衡器，一次只能删除一条。
descriptions.en: Delete a load balancer by its ID, only one can be deleted at a time.
